maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from annuities, life insurance and retirement plan products sold to customers, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are individuals, employers and retirement plan participants paying for annuities, life insurance and retirement services, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling annuities, life insurance and retirement plans organically through advisors and institutions, not through regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Long-term annuities, life policies and retirement plan recordkeeping are costly and disruptive to move, with surrender charges and plan transitions.
